page.overview:
Who is Ashley?

Ashley is a third-grader at Springfield Elementary School.

She was revealed to be in Audrey McConnell's third grade class, which was seen in the episode "Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade".

She appeared in "Lisa Vs. Malibu Stacy", where she was one of several girls shopping for new Malibu Stacy dolls at the Springfield Mall.

Her hair color as well as the color of her clothes have changed in previous and latter episodes. In some episodes her hair color is brown, while others it's black.
